   - Half of the 36 cubic feet is:

     \]
   - The remaining water volume is:
     \[
     36 \, \text{cubic feet} - 18 \, \text{cubic feet} = 18 \, \text{cubic feet}
     \]

   - Nancy triples the remaining water volume.
   - Tripling 18 cubic feet gives:
     \[
     18 \, \text{cubic feet} \times 3 = 54 \, \text{cubic feet}
     \]
